units: alpha in [0,1], times and fixed duration in milliseconds
interpolation: Linear from alpha at request time to new target over a fresh 150ms duration. Sample current animation at request time before retargeting. A stale complete(epoch) must do nothing, including no sampling. Every new request increments epoch once; enabling reduced motion invalidates prior work. schedule(callback) returns one cancelable handle; at most one active handle. render(alpha) changes appearance only. Semantic expanded changes immediately on request; closing restores focus then, not in a completion callback. No render or scheduling after unmount.
brokenBehavior: Every request restarts alpha at an endpoint and leaves its old loop active. Every completion sets expanded=true. Reduced-motion only changes a CSS duration. Unmount leaves handles alive.

frameObservations.target: one synthetic trace, not a device benchmark
